notes: Discovered via robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow) -> sitemap_collections_1.xml (~1338 collection URLs scanned for holiday/seasonal vocabulary, no wayback/cache used) -> confirmed each candidate's og:title/meta description via direct HTTP fetch -> exact qty via the storefront's own Algolia Shopify-app index (app AVKHUU7E0V, index shopify_products, collections facet filter, default filters NOT named_tags.algolia-hidden / NOT meta.global.variant_hidden applied - same filters the live widget applies), cross-checked with Claude-in-Chrome render of /collections/fall-collection to resolve one ambiguity. Site brands its holiday shop as 'Holiday' throughout but on-page copy explicitly ties it to Christmas ('Elevate your Christmas tree' on the ornaments page, 'Christmas decor' text block on the Holiday Decor page), so category is normalized to Christmas per rules 3/11 rather than kept generic. Site has no Halloween/Thanksgiving/Valentine/Easter/Diwali/other-festival categories (checked full collections sitemap + Algolia facet-search against the full rules-3 vocabulary list, zero genuine matches). Included: Holiday (179, umbrella holiday/gift decor PLP), Holiday Decor (46, ~98% subset of Holiday but merchant-maintained as its own PLP), Wreaths & Garlands (21) and Stockings & Mantel Decor (46) (both linked in the live mega menu / discoverable via sitemap, only partial overlap with Holiday so kept as separate leaves, not folded into a grouping row), Holiday Gifting (170, og:title 'Holiday Gifting', described as holiday-season gifts). Excluded per core/seasonal rules: New Holiday (100% subset of Holiday = New Arrivals filter), Sale Holiday (Sale), Holiday Decor Under $60/$100 and Gifts Under $60/$150/Over $150 (price-tier filters, 98-100% subsets of their parent PLPs), Sarah Sherman Samuel Holiday and Cody Foster Ornaments + Holiday Decor (designer/brand-name listing pages, the latter also only 1 item), Holiday Entertaining and Ornaments + Tree Toppers/Skirts (both live pages with real SEO copy but 0 products in the Algolia index right now - dropped per the 0-product-categories-are-dropped convention rather than written as a qty:0 row). Boundary call, logged here rather than guessed: Fall Collection and Spring Collection (both real nav items under New > Collections, 'Autumn/Fall'/'Spring' are valid vocabulary per rules-3) were investigated with a live Chrome render of /collections/fall-collection - its own category tabs (Furniture/Rugs/Lighting/etc.) resolve to /collections/new-furniture, /collections/new-rugs, etc. (the generic New-Arrivals sub-collections, not fall-specific ones), and fall-collection is an 86% subset of the plain /collections/new listing. Judged this to be New Arrivals re-branded by season rather than a genuine seasonal category, so excluded both, along with the unlinked orphan collections fall-collection-copy, spring-collection-2025, and the 8 fall-rugs/fall-furniture/fall-pillows-throws/fall-walls/fall-bed-bath/fall-decor/fall-lighting/fall-tabletop sub-collections and 3 spring-rugs/spring-furniture/spring-hues sub-collections, none of which are linked from any live navigation found (sitemap-only, confirmed by checking the rendered Fall Collection page for cross-links). Also excluded as non-genuine seasonal categories: Italian Summer and A Cotswolds Summer (aesthetic 'shop the look' room-inspiration pages, not a seasonal shopping period), Seasonal Glamour and Seasonal Standout (dining-room style-inspiration pages, 'seasonal' used as a design-trend word not a holiday), New Year Refresh (general January home-refresh campaign, no New Year's Eve/party/decor products), Outdoor Entertaining (general year-round entertaining category, not holiday-tied).
